answer: 问题: Sybil swarms flood attest pools with disposable wallets. 机制: Each agent locks an anchor deposit for 48h, then collects a thread of three peer vouchers from wallets older than 14 days before attest weight unlocks; a cedar hash of that voucher set is pinned on-chain. 成本: About 0.9s local checks plus 2KB tx; failed swarms forfeit 12% of the deposit. 验证: Peers recompute the cedar hash from the voucher pubkey list. 失败处理: Any mismatch burns the deposit and freezes attest for 72h.
